mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orderCount, IFNULL(SUM(total_amount), 0) AS turnover, IFNULL(SUM(item_count), 0) AS dishCount FROM orders WHERE status <> '已取消'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS orderCount, IFNULL(SUM(total_amount), 0) AS turnover FROM orders WHERE status <> '已取消' AND DATE(created_at) = CURDATE()
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS usingCount, COUNT(*) AS totalCount FROM dining_table
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = '待处理'

SELECT i.dish_id AS dishId, i.dish_name AS name, i.emoji AS emoji, SUM(i.`count`) AS soldCount, SUM(i.subtotal) AS amount FROM order_item i JOIN orders o ON o.id = i.order_id WHERE o.status <> '已取消' GROUP BY i.dish_id, i.dish_name, i.emoji ORDER BY soldCount DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT c.name AS categoryName, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN o.id IS NOT NULL THEN i.`count` ELSE 0 END), 0) AS soldCount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN o.id IS NOT NULL THEN i.subtotal ELSE 0 END), 0) AS amount FROM category c LEFT JOIN dish d ON d.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN order_item i ON i.dish_id = d.id LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.id = i.order_id AND o.status <> '已取消' GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY amount DESC
